title: Drift League
premise: Hover-kart street racing for kids: boost mixes, pit stops, rival crews and track maps.

companion.name: SPARK
companion.about: the kart's AI, cocky and trash-talking, speaks from the dashboard

cast.BECK: mechanic; grumpy, never wrong about engines

fragments.style: Middle-grade graphic novel panel, clean cel-shaded coloring, bold black ink outlines, rounded cartoon characters with big expressive faces, rich saturated colors, racing orange, chrome silver and neon teal palette
fragments.notext: Wordless art, all surfaces blank, no lettering, no numbers, no speech bubbles, one single continuous scene filling the whole image with no panel borders, frames, bands or split sections
fragments.zara: a girl age 11 with dark brown skin, box braids tied back, an orange racing jacket and fingerless gloves
fragments.beck: a boy age 11 with pale skin, a buzz cut, oil-smudged gray overalls and a wrench in his back pocket
fragments.lin: a girl age 11 with light skin, a black ponytail, a teal windbreaker and a tablet
fragments.omar: a boy age 11 with medium brown skin, short black hair, a headset microphone and a striped referee-style shirt
fragments.spark: a small glowing teal dashboard screen with a simple cartoon face of two dot eyes and a smile
fragments.kart: a sleek low hover-kart with no wheels, glowing teal underlights, orange paint and racing stripes, hovering above the ground
fragments.track: a neon-lit city street race track with ramps, barriers, pit garages and cheering crowds
